findings.title: Retain DECA's stated selection factors separately from eligibility

evidence.candidateObservation: The retained corporate-program passage names DECA involvement, leadership ability, community service and academic performance. None appears in row352's typed values; the need observation retains only merit wording.

findings.rationale: These are explicit program-scoped selection observations. Omitting them from the typed record loses material source detail and its distinction from mandatory eligibility. The structural verifier checks existing values but cannot detect this omission.
findings.requestedAuthorRepair: Add a held general-DECA corporate-program selection observation retaining all four factors and donor-specific criteria, with exact existing source evidence, scope, routing and a semantic assertion. Explicitly avoid converting selection factors into mandatory child eligibility, scoring, accepted facts or hard exclusions.
